value.description: Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository

include_claim_keys.description: Array of unique strings. Each claim key can only contain alphanumeric characters and underscores.

sub_claim_prefix.description: The current `sub` claim prefix for this repository.

use_default.description: Whether to use the default template or not. If `true`, the `include_claim_keys` field is ignored.

use_immutable_subject.description: Whether the repository has opted in to the immutable OIDC subject claim format. When `true`, OIDC tokens will use a stable, repository-ID-based `sub` claim. If not set at the repository level, falls back to the organization-level setting.
